Defines Firedancer actions, tiles, callbacks, and config presets, then calls fd_dev_main.

# Purpose
This file defines the entry point for the `firedancer-dev` executable. It sets the application name in `FD_APP_NAME` and `FD_BINARY_NAME`, then builds lists of available topology object callbacks in `CALLBACKS`, configuration stages in `STAGES`, runtime tiles in `TILES`, and command actions in `ACTIONS`. These arrays collect the external components that the program can use during startup, configuration, and execution.

The [`main`](<#main>) function creates the built-in configuration sets with `fd_config_file_default()`, `fd_config_file_testnet()`, `fd_config_file_devnet()`, and `fd_config_file_mainnet()`, stores them in `configs`, and then calls `fd_dev_main()`. That call passes the command line arguments, the configuration list, and `fd_topo_initialize` as the topology setup function. The file does not implement the individual tiles, actions, or configuration stages; it only registers them and starts the development application.
